changes: Dropped 2 near-duplicate/constant features (|Spearman rho| >= 0.99): ['f10', 'f7']. See fable5-criteo-feature-redundancy.md.

Row-level duplicate-feature-vector leakage (~15.2% of rows) is NOT fixed here — all rows are kept. It's fixed at train/test split time in run_nir_benchmark.py via a group-safe GroupShuffleSplit (grouped by a hash of the full feature vector), since the right fix is 'never split a duplicate pair across train/test', not 'drop the duplicate'. See fable5-criteo-duplicate-feature-vectors-inflate-metrics.md.
